example_messages: Issues tombstoned in DB still present in JSONL
DB delete didn't propagate to sidecar JSONL
detector_hint: diff DB tombstone set vs JSONL ID set; report rows in JSONL that are tombstoned in DB
fixer_hint: rewrite JSONL to drop tombstoned rows; fsync; backup original to backups/

example_messages: WAL sidecar exists without matching SHM sidecar (frankensqlite)
detector_hint: check existence + mtime of <db>-wal and <db>-shm sidecars; flag if one without other or stale
fixer_hint: quarantine the orphaned sidecar (Op::Rename to .doctor/runs/<id>/quarantine/); restart sqlite cleanly

example_messages: database disk image is malformed: page N is never used
detector_hint: run PRAGMA integrity_check; non-'ok' result = finding
fixer_hint: reconstruct DB from JSONL/git archive; preserve quarantined original

example_messages: lockfile contains PID of non-existent process
detector_hint: read PID from lockfile; check kill -0 on PID; if not running and lockfile mtime > N seconds, finding
fixer_hint: remove stale lockfile via Op::Rename to quarantine/

example_messages: Harden PID hint file against symlink TOCTOU attacks
race window between stat and open
detector_hint: check that PID hint files are written via O_NOFOLLOW; symlink checks happen-before open
fixer_hint: recreate PID hint file with proper open flags; quarantine any symlink found in its place

example_messages: potential deadlock: drop mutex guard before async channel send
nested lock deadlock between A and B
detector_hint: static analysis on Rust source: any .await call inside a MutexGuard scope (clippy::await_holding_lock)
fixer_hint: flag for human review; not auto-fixable

example_messages: on-disk schema_version differs from binary's compiled version
detector_hint: read schema_version from DB metadata; compare to compiled-in constant
fixer_hint: run migration if forward-compatible; refuse with exit 4 if backward-only

detector_hint: read first line of JSONL; expect schema_version comment or {schema_version:N} record
fixer_hint: add schema_version preamble to JSONL based on observed record shape

example_messages: node_modules out of sync with package-lock
detector_hint: compare mtime of build artifacts against source manifest
fixer_hint: NOT auto-fixable (deletion-equivalent); recommend manual `cargo clean` per AGENTS.md only-undo-deletes axiom

example_messages: stale recovery files from prior crash
preserved recovery artifacts remain after success
detector_hint: list .doctor/.recovery/ entries; flag any older than --gc-window
fixer_hint: refuse without --yes (deletion-equivalent); offer `<tool> doctor gc --before <date> --yes`

detector_hint: parse the config; non-zero parser exit = finding
fixer_hint: NOT auto-fixable in general (user intent ambiguous); offer to back up + emit minimal valid config skeleton

example_messages: dotenv parser emits literal backslash before escaped char
escape handling broken for newline literals
detector_hint: parse .env file with strict escape semantics; differ vs lax-parser output
fixer_hint: flag for review; not auto-fixable (changes user data)

example_messages: env var name collides with another tool
XDG path resolved to unexpected dir
detector_hint: check for known-conflicting env var names (e.g., NODE_OPTIONS, PYTHONPATH)
fixer_hint: NOT auto-fixable; emit a manual_remediations entry

detector_hint: online-only: probe HTTPS endpoint; check cert expiry
fixer_hint: online_required=true; recommend dependency upgrade for webpki-roots

example_messages: Harden static file serving against symlink traversal
detector_hint: walk archive entries; check that no symlink target escapes root
fixer_hint: quarantine the offending symlink; emit warning

detector_hint: check mtime of credential files vs documented rotation cadence
fixer_hint: NOT auto-fixable (user must re-authenticate); manual_remediations entry

example_messages: refs pointing at oid never written to ODB (git 2.51.0 segfault mid-stash)
detector_hint: git for-each-ref; for each ref, git cat-file -e <oid>; non-zero = orphan
fixer_hint: with --fix, git update-ref -d <ref> after backup; refuse without --yes

example_messages: loose objects accumulating; archive needs git gc
detector_hint: count loose-object dirs; flag if > N
fixer_hint: git -c gc.auto=0 maintenance run --task=loose-objects; reversible (no data deleted)

detector_hint: stat each sensitive path; compare mode to expected (0600 / 0700)
fixer_hint: Op::Chmod to expected mode; reversible via undo

example_messages: AlreadyExists/PermissionDenied race on PID hint file
detector_hint: check that PID hint write uses O_CREAT|O_EXCL with retry
fixer_hint: flag for code review; not auto-fixable

detector_hint: compare port-state cache vs lsof -i live readout
fixer_hint: invalidate cache; rebuild from live probe

example_messages: DB row count differs from JSONL line count
detector_hint: count(*) on DB vs wc -l on JSONL; also compare last_export vs last_import timestamps
fixer_hint: re-sync; rewrite the lagging surface from the source-of-truth
